title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1982-09-18
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> SoundDevices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Samplitude Professional v8.0 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: A decent audience recording captures a memorable but modest show.
ai_review.review: The tape is praised for its surprisingly clear capture despite the difficult venue, offering a solid audience‑recorded listening experience. The concert itself is remembered fondly by several reviewers as a good, if not legendary, performance that marked many first Dead experiences.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers generally enjoy the show and note a good recording, but they also describe the performance as only average, leading to a moderate overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Venue was difficult to hear, yet the audience tape is considered clear and captures the show well; reviewers note it as a solid alternative to the passable soundboard source.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Briefly mentioned taking a short break; no specific performance commentary.
